label: architect • CSV reconcile with a per-row lookup, approval, and a report folder
query:
Each month I export invoices from our bookkeeping app as a CSV, like the sample at {{fixture.files_dir}}/invoices.csv (columns: invoice_id, customer, amount). Our billing system has the real amounts: GET {{fixture.base_url}}/v1/invoices/<invoice_id> returns {"id", "amount", "status"}.

Make a workflow where I pick the CSV, it checks every row against billing, and when an amount doesn't match it shows me the mismatches so I can approve them before it writes a reconciliation report into a reports folder I choose once. Test it with the sample file and offer to save it.
notes: Hard case. A file input, one billing lookup per row (map + http), a form that asks for approval when amounts differ (INV-2 is off by 5.00), and the report written to a declared folder rather than a path from this Mac. The scripted answers approve.
